book.article: Erdos' Problem on Covering Systems with Distinct Moduli, Zhi-Wei Sun, printed104-106
book.relationship: Sun8 is the exact k=8 specialization of the article's unrestricted disjoint-left-coset conjecture, not its distinct-modulus-cover question.

primary_sources.finding: Exact all-group conjecture, finite-index subgroups, pairwise disjoint LEFT cosets, no cover condition.

primary_sources.finding: Arbitrary-group Sun3/4; not Sun8. These are exact classical theorem imports.

primary_sources.work: Margolis-Schnabel, The Herzog-Schonheim conjecture for small groups and harmonic subgroups
primary_sources.read_scope: Definitions1.1/2.1, TheoremB at length<=4, product lemmas3.7-3.10 and Corollary3.9; Prop4.5 statement and local proof
primary_sources.finding: G-to-Z transfer only up to4; Prop4.5 exact (2q1,4q2,4q3,4q4) obstruction with pairwise-coprime cofactors and odd q1. These are not a general transfer or Sun8.
